validated_tasks.name: View Item Details
validated_tasks.description: The user wants to learn more about a product before deciding to add it to their cart.

steps.description: Navigate to the website's homepage.
Locate a product of interest, like 'Elmwood Inn Fine Teas, Orange Vanilla Caffeine-free Fruit Infusion'.
Click on the product card or 'View Details' link to see more information about the product.

validated_tasks.name: Explore Product Categories
validated_tasks.description: The user wants to explore products within specific categories to find items they are interested in.

steps.description: Navigate to the website's homepage.
Review the list of categories such as 'Beauty & Personal Care', 'Sports & Outdoors', and 'Electronics'.
Select a category to view all available products within that category.

validated_tasks.name: Manage Wish List
validated_tasks.description: The user wants to add items to their wish list for future reference or purchase.

steps.description: Navigate to the website's homepage and sign in to the account.
Browse or search for items of interest.
On the product details page or from the product listing, select the option to 'Add to Wish List'.
Access 'My Wish List' from the account dashboard to view or manage the list.

validated_tasks.name: Filter Products by Rating
validated_tasks.description: The user wants to filter and view products sorted by their rating to find the best-reviewed items.

steps.description: Navigate to the website's homepage.
Look for filter or sort options on the product listing page.
Select 'Sort by Rating' or apply a rating filter to show products with high customer ratings.
Review the filtered results to find the highest-rated products.

validated_tasks.name: Compare Products
validated_tasks.description: The user wants to compare multiple products side-by-side to make an informed purchasing decision.

steps.description: Navigate to the website's homepage and find products of interest.
Click 'Add to Compare' button on multiple products.
Access the comparison page to view side-by-side details of the selected products.
Review the specifications and pricing to help decide which product to purchase.

validated_tasks.name: View Shopping Cart
validated_tasks.description: The user wants to check the contents of their shopping cart before proceeding to checkout.

steps.description: Navigate to the website and add items to the cart as needed.
Click on 'My Cart' link in the header navigation.
Review the list of items, quantities, and total price in the shopping cart.
Make any adjustments to item quantities or remove items if needed.

validated_tasks.name: Apply Coupon Code
validated_tasks.description: The user wants to apply a discount coupon code to their order to reduce the total purchase price.

steps.description: Navigate to the website and add desired items to the shopping cart.
Go to the shopping cart page by clicking 'My Cart'.
Look for a 'Coupon Code' or 'Promo Code' field on the cart or checkout page.
Enter the coupon code and click 'Apply' to see the discounted total.
